refinements.description: グレー寄りの薄茶色とカピバラらしい鼻先
refinements.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1: exact edit target, the existing sleepy capybara in bath (currently blue-gray). Input image 2: bear comparison ONLY; do not copy its face anatomy. The user wants a brownish capybara that is visually distinct from the orange-brown grizzly.
Primary request: refine the capybara's FUR COLOR and HEAD ANATOMY while preserving the cozy thick chocolate-brown outline, small body, sleepy satisfied expression, head leaf, bath and steam.
Color: head, small ears, body and paws should be LIGHT GRAYISH TAUPE / CAFE-AU-LAIT BROWN (#bca98e), natural brown but much less orange and lighter than the bear, restrained soft matte fill. Muzzle pale warm taupe (#ded1bb), not a high-contrast cream oval patch like the bear. Dusty pink cheek blush, muted green leaf and muted teal bath unchanged. Absolutely no blue fur in final.
Anatomy: make unmistakably CAPYBARA, not bear. Change head to a slightly taller softly RECTANGULAR shape with a flatter top and softly squared side edges, tiny high-set ears about half the target's current ear size. Slight three-quarter view so the BROAD LONG BLUNT PROTRUDING RECTANGULAR MUZZLE is readable; its lower snout is longer and more horizontal, not the bear's little oval muzzle. Nose is two tiny dark brown paired nostril marks near tip of blunt snout rather than a large bear-style oval/triangle nose. Small sleepy half-closed eyes, calm flat eyebrows and little satisfied curved smile. The face remains gentle, simple, huge relative to its tiny body, no realistic fur. Maintain pleasant cartoon symmetry adapted to slight angle, no angular realism.
Keep all of the ORIGINAL bath pose, little paws resting at water edge, small green leaf atop head, two ivory steam curls, small oval blue-teal water surface. No rocks or extra objects. Thick dark-brown contour weight consistent with input. Complete full character visible, centered square canvas with original scale, generous margins. Genuine transparent background, cream parts inside illustration opaque. No text, no watermark.

refinements.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1: exact EDIT TARGET, the existing silver-gray friendly doberman mascot.
Primary request: add a modest amount of SILVER combat equipment that suggests an honorable guardian ready to fight, while preserving the cute character. The user explicitly says not to overdo equipment.
Keep the exact dog face, huge head and tiny seated body proportions, floppy ears, gray-and-tan fur, firm determined-but-kind brows, small confident closed smile, dark-brown dot eyes and nose, thick chocolate-brown outline, matte soft fills and transparent background.
Equipment: a SIMPLE SMALL MATTE SILVER BREASTPLATE over the chest below the existing muted blue collar. Rounded upper corners, one soft tapered bottom, 1–2 broad understated pale silver highlights and muted silver-gray edge; it covers only chest, not paws. Keep small visible bits of blue collar. The existing tiny gold shield badge may remain centered on collar as a very small accent. In ONE forepaw, add a SMALL rounded silver shield held LOW to one side at paw/body height, never up in front of face; silver-gray rim with plain pale silver center and at most one small darker simple vertical panel. Shift only this paw enough to hold the shield. Other paws, ears and tail unchanged.
Chestplate and shield are two tiny accessories, combined area small, dog face dominates. No helmet, no crown, no sword/gun/large weapon, no armor all over legs, no intricate buckles, no shiny photorealistic metal, no aggression or teeth. Rounded cute silver equipment with same thick brown outlines and simple 2D style, original square framing, full ears and all paws visible. No ground shadow, no new scenery, no text, no watermark. Background remains genuinely transparent.
